rows.name: search-exact-500
rows.source: set v [lrepeat 499 tea];lappend v coffee;lsearch -exact $v coffee

rows.name: search-glob-300
rows.source: set v [lrepeat 299 tea];lappend v coffee;lsearch -glob $v cof*

rows.name: sort-ascii-200
rows.source: set v {};for {set i 200} {$i>0} {incr i -1} {lappend v rack$i};lindex [lsort $v] end

rows.name: search-sorted-500
rows.source: set v {};for {set i 0} {$i<500} {incr i} {lappend v $i};set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<50} {incr i} {incr total [lsearch -sorted -integer $v 499]};set total

rows.name: array-regexp-100
rows.source: array set a {};for {set i 0} {$i<100} {incr i} {set a(rack$i) $i};llength [array names a -regexp {^rack[0-9]+$}]

rows.name: sort-dictionary-200
rows.source: set v {};for {set i 200} {$i>0} {incr i -1} {lappend v rack$i};lindex [lsort -dictionary $v] end

scope: Eight small warm-session collection workloads, native and Node measured separately on one host; exact results verified. Different host adapters; no full application, peak memory or cross-platform acceptance.
